name: GPU Volume Reconstruction via Conjugate Gradient
definition: Solving the ill-conditioned linear system $Wa = o$ for volume properties $a$ (albedo, emission, extinction) using Conjugate Gradient minimization on the GPU, avoiding explicit storage of the large sparse matrix $W$.
summary: GPU Volume Reconstruction via Conjugate Gradient reconstructs volume properties by solving linear systems on the GPU using implicit matrix-vector products via ray marching, avoiding explicit matrix storage.
